description: One gridded value at one time, latitude and longitude from an IOOS regional model or radar grid — ocean temperature, salinity, currents, or WRF atmospheric fields. ERDDAP snaps to the nearest grid cell. AUTHORITATIVE for regional-resolution conditions that a global product misses: PacIOOS ROMS resolves individual Hawaiian channels, which no global grid does.

dataset_id.description: Griddap dataset id, e.g. "roms_hiig" on the pacioos node.

depth.description: Depth in metres — REQUIRED for 4-D ocean model grids such as PacIOOS ROMS, whose axes are time, depth, latitude, longitude. Omitting it on such a dataset is an axis error.

longitude.description: Decimal degrees east (negative for the western hemisphere).

node.description: Which IOOS ERDDAP to ask. Each regional association holds different datasets and a dataset id from one will not resolve on another. "national" = IOOS-wide inventories, asset and metric datasets; "sensors" = the national in-situ sensor network — buoys, tide gauges, met stations; "gliders" = every US underwater glider deployment, temperature/salinity profiles; "pacioos" = Hawaii and the Pacific Islands — ROMS and WRF model grids, reef monitoring; "secoora" = the US Southeast — North Carolina through Florida and the eastern Gulf; "gcoos" = the Gulf of Mexico. Default "sensors", the national in-situ network.

time.description: ISO timestamp, or the literal "last" for the newest available step (default).

variable.description: Gridded variable name, e.g. "temp" or "salt". Case-sensitive; see ioos_erddap_dataset_info.
